mapper.select: select DISTINCT `date` from t_eastmoney_node_index teni where stockCode = '1.000001' and `date` >= '2021-01-01' and not exists (select 1 from t_eastmoney_node_cci t2 where teni.`date` = t2.date) and date not like '9999%' order by 1
mapper.insert: replace into t_eastmoney_node_cci(`date`, `stockCode`, `cci5`, `cci10`, `cci14`) with tmp as ( select `date` -- , lag(`date`, 1) over (partition by stockCode order by ten.`date` ) data_pre_1 -- , lag(`date`, 60) over (partition by stockCode order by ten.`date` ) data_pre_60 , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by ten.`date` desc) date_rank , last , stockCode , chg , round((high + low + `last`)/3, 6) tp from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{calcDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') , INTERVAL -60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.`date` <= #{calcDate} -- and ten.stockCode = '1.600118' order by ten.`date` desc ) , tmp_md as ( select t1.stockCode , max(case when t1.date_rank <= 1 then t1.date else null end) date , max(case when t1.date_rank <= 1 then t1.tp else null end) tp , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 5 then t1.tp else null end), 6) avg_tp_5 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 10 then t1.tp else null end), 6) avg_tp_10 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 14 then t1.tp else null end), 6) avg_tp_14 from tmp t1 where exists (select 1 from tmp t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t2.date_rank = 14) group by t1.stockCode ) , tmp_avgdev as ( select t1.stockCode , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 5 then abs(t2.avg_tp_5 - t1.tp) else null end), 6) avg_dev_5 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 10 then abs(t2.avg_tp_10 - t1.tp) else null end), 6) avg_dev_10 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank <= 14 then abs(t2.avg_tp_14 - t1.tp) else null end), 6) avg_dev_14 from tmp t1, tmp_md t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode group by t1.stockCode ) -- (TYP-MA(TYP,84))/(0.015*AVEDEV(TYP,84)),COLORFF00FF; select -- round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_5)/t2.avg_dev/0.015, 2) cci_5, t1.* t1.date , t1.stockCode -- , concat('cci ', round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_5)/t2.avg_dev_5/0.015, 2)) cci_5 , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_5)/(case when t2.avg_dev_5 < 0.0000001 then 0.0000001 else t2.avg_dev_5 end )/0.015, 2) cci5 , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_10)/(case when t2.avg_dev_10 < 0.0000001 then 0.0000001 else t2.avg_dev_10 end )/0.015, 2) cci10 , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_14)/(case when t2.avg_dev_14 < 0.0000001 then 0.0000001 else t2.avg_dev_14 end )/0.015, 2) cci14 -- , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_5)/t2.avg_dev_5/0.015, 2) cci5 -- , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_10)/t2.avg_dev_10/0.015, 2) cci10 -- , round((t1.tp - t1.avg_tp_14)/t2.avg_dev_14/0.015, 2) cci14 from tmp_md t1, tmp_avgdev t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode order by 1, 2
mapper.select: with tmp_min_date as (select DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') min_date) , tmp_base_info as ( select ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.volume , ten.`last` , lag(ten.`low`, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date desc) low_next_1 , ten.chg , lag(ten.`last`, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date desc) last_next_1 , lag(ten.`last`, 2) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date desc) last_next_2 , lag(ten.`last`, 5) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date desc) last_next_5 , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) date_rn from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_min_date tmd where ten.`date` not like '9999%' and ten.`date` > tmd.min_date order by 1 desc ) -- 1、考虑低量 , tmp_vol as ( select ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.volume , lag(ten.`date`, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) date_pre_1 , lag(ten.`volume`, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) vol_pre_1 , lag(ten.`volume`, 2) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) vol_pre_2 , lag(ten.`volume`, 3) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) vol_pre_3 , lag(ten.`volume`, 4) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by date) vol_pre_4 , ten.`last` from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_min_date tmd where ten.`date` not like '9999%' and ten.chg < 0.5 and ten.`date` > tmd.min_date order by 1 desc ) -- 找出近5日的，量最低的 , tmp_consider_vol as ( select tv.* from tmp_vol tv where tv.volume <= least(tv.vol_pre_1, vol_pre_2, vol_pre_3, vol_pre_4) -- or tv.date = '2025-12-15' ) -- select * from tmp_consider_vol where stockCode = '1.603920' order by 1 desc; -- 2、考虑cci , tmp_cci as ( select tenc.`date` , tenc.stockCode , tenc.cci14 , rank() over (partition by tenc.stockCode order by date desc) date_rn , lag(tenc.`date`, 5) over (partition by tenc.stockCode order by date) date_pre_5 from t_eastmoney_node_cci tenc, tmp_min_date tmd where 1 = 1 and tenc.`date` > tmd.min_date order by 1 desc ) , tmp_cci_d as ( select t1.*, t2.cci14 cci14_2, t2.date_rn date_rn_2 from tmp_cci t1, tmp_cci t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t2.date_rn BETWEEN t1.date_rn and t1.date_rn + 6 order by t1.date_rn , date_rn_2 ) , tmp_consider_cci as ( select td.date, td.date_pre_5 , td.stockCode , max(case when td.date_rn = date_rn_2 then td.cci14_2 else null end) cci14_2 , sum(case when td.cci14_2 < -100 then 1 else 0 end) cci_low_cnt_100_n , sum(case when td.cci14_2 < -150 then 1 else 0 end) cci_low_cnt_150_n , ifnull(min(case when td.cci14_2 > -100 then td.date_rn_2 else null end), 0) cci_1 , ifnull(min(case when td.cci14_2 < -100 then td.date_rn_2 else null end), 0) cci_2 , ifnull(max(case when td.cci14_2 > -100 then td.date_rn_2 else null end), 0) cci_4 , count(1) date_cnt from tmp_cci_d td group by td.date, td.stockCode having cci_low_cnt_100_n > 0 and cci_low_cnt_100_n <= 3 and cci_low_cnt_150_n = 0 and cci_1 > 0 and cci_2 > 0 and cci_4 > 0 and cci_1 < cci_2 AND cci_2 < cci_4 and date_cnt = 7 order by td.date desc ) -- select * from tmp_consider_cci t1 where stockCode = '0.000400'; -- 3、考虑大振幅 , tmp_bigswing as ( select ten.stockCode fullStockCode, th.stockCode , th.bkName, th.stockName , count(1) cnt , sum(case when (ten.high - ten.low ) / ( ten.`last` / (1+ten.chg*0.01)) > 0.04 then 1 else 0 end) big_swing_cnt from t_eastmoney_node ten, t_hs300 th where date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.`date` not like '9999%' and th.fullStockCode = ten.stockCode and th.stockCode not like '30%' and th.stockCode not like '68%' group by ten.stockCode , th.stockCode , th.bkName, th.stockName ) , tmp_consider_bigswing as ( select t.* , rank() over (partition by t.bkName order by big_swing_cnt desc) rank_ from tmp_bigswing t ) , tmp_ans_bigswing as ( select * from tmp_consider_bigswing where big_swing_cnt > cnt * 0.6 and rank_ <= 5 ) -- select * from tmp_t_bigswing; -- 考虑 cci 和 vol , tmp_ans as ( select distinct th.stockCode stockCode , t1.date , t2.date date_2 , concat(th.bkName, '-', th.stockName) last , concat('cci14: ', t1.cci14_2) ratioB, th.fullStockCode from tmp_consider_cci t1, tmp_consider_vol t2, t_hs300 th where t2.date BETWEEN t1.date_pre_5 and t1.`date` and t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t1.stockCode = th.fullStockCode and th.stockCode not like '30%' and th.stockCode not like '68%' ) -- select * from tmp_ans where stockCode = '000400'; -- order by 2 desc, 1 , tmp_ans_rank_1 as ( select distinct t1.stockCode, t1.date, t1.last, t1.ratioB, t1.fullStockCode, t2.last last_0, t2.low_next_1, t2.last_next_1, t2.last_next_2, t2.last_next_5, t2.date_rn from tmp_ans t1, tmp_base_info t2 where t1.date = t2.date and t1.fullStockCode = t2.stockCode ) , tmp_ans_rank_2 as ( select t1.*, t1.date_rn - rank() over (partition by t1.stockCode order by t1.date) date_rank_2 from tmp_ans_rank_1 t1 ) , tmp_ans_rank_3 as ( select t1.*, rank() over (partition by t1.stockCode, t1.date_rank_2 order by t1.date_rn) date_rank_3 from tmp_ans_rank_2 t1 ) select t1.stockCode, t1.date, t1.last , concat(t1.ratioB, '__五日内win: ', case when t1.last_0 > last_next_2 and t1.last_0 > last_next_5 then 'No' else 'Yes' end) ratioB from tmp_ans_rank_3 t1 where 1 = 1 and date_rank_3 = 1 and exists (select 1 from tmp_ans_bigswing t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode) order by 2 desc, 3
